items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Oh yeah I liked him, I thought he was a nice guy.

ctx.x: I had never seen any of those guys perform. They come into watch us and listen to us. I never had the chance to go to one of their concerts cause I never knew when it was going to be. Sometimes it was like they only told special people where they were going to have a concert.
And also there was a relationship between Trane and Babatunde, Babatunde Olatunji.
Oh yeah I liked him, I thought he was a nice guy. Michael Olatunji, Nigeria. You know he was a general in the Nigerian Army, did you know that?
